Isaac Morley was the second patriarch and first to be assigned to a specific locale: Far West, Missouri (see “Minute Book 2,” 85,josephsmithpapers.org). The Church Patriarch was referred to both by the title “Presiding Patriarch” and “Patriarch to the Church”; see Edward L. Kimball,Lengthen Your Stride: The Presidency of Spencer W. Kimball(Salt Lake City: Deseret Book, 2005), 259; “The Sustaining of Church Officers,”Ensign,Nov. 1979, 18.

Doctrine and Covenants 124:91–96; “The Sustaining of Church Officers,”Ensign,Nov. 1979, 18. All but George F. Richards, who served as Acting Patriarch between 1937 and 1942, were descendants of Joseph Smith Sr.’s father, Asael Smith; see Bates and Smith,Lost Legacy,Appendix B: “Mormon Presiding Patriarchs.”
